title: Build the complete image-analysis pipeline
intro: Integrate Python debugging, metadata integrity, interpretable figures, source provenance and genuine credited image-pixel processing. A faithful *method exercise*, not a reproduced raw-data biological claim.

chapter_method: Predict → Run → Investigate → Apply → independent Prove → delayed review.
